summary: Suzi Plays pulls on the Thunderbolt Selected Summons banner up to 340 summons to claim Perkunte from the 300-pull selector, but strongly advises non-whales to skip the banner. Thunderbolt is currently not part of the top meta compared to Aura, Toxin, Burn, Dauntless, or Ice Blast. She also highlights the Starweave Echo event, recommending players save duplicate Legendary Soul Imprints to exchange for Starweave Fragments in the Temporal Corridor to buy top legendaries like Maashtur or Guinavivre.

meta_changes: Thunderbolt element is currently outclassed by Aura, Toxin, Burn, Dauntless, and Ice Blast teams.
The Starweave Echo event allows converting duplicate Legendary Soul Imprints into 12 Starweave Fragments each (up to 50 times) to buy top-tier legendaries in the Temporal Corridor.
tips: Skip the Thunderbolt banner unless you can afford 300+ pulls on every banner, as Thunderbolt is currently not meta.
Save duplicate Legendary Soul Imprints for the Starweave Echo event to purchase top legendaries like Maashtur (800 fragments) or Guinavivre (300 fragments).
Never waste currency on cheap or non-rotating legendary options in Temporal Corridor; save strictly for high-tier rotating legendaries.
Save summon dice and resources for the upcoming Child of Chaos event.
